about: Brad Johnson Injury Law is a personal injury firm with a single office in Glendale.

The firm states that it works on a contingency fee, with nothing to pay unless the case is won; the first consultation is free; its intake line is open around the clock; it will visit clients in hospital or at home. It publishes material in English and Spanish.

completeness.note: Categories, opening hours and photo count come from the Places API. json_ld_descriptions: Brad Johnson Injury Law is a premier personal injury law firm serving Arizona with over 30 years of experience. Specializing in car accidents, truck accidents, motorcycle injuries, dog bites, pedestrian accidents, and bicycle injuries. Lowest attorney fees in Arizona at 25%. No fees unless we win.

Brad Johnson Injury Law provides comprehensive personal injury legal services for accident victims throughout Arizona. With over 30 years of experience, we specialize in car accidents, truck collisions, motorcycle crashes, dog bites, pedestrian injuries, and bicycle accidents. Serving Phoenix, Glendale, Peoria, Goodyear, Avondale, Buckeye, Surprise, and all Arizona communities. 24/7 support with the lowest attorney fees in Arizona - only 25%. No fees unless we win your case. Free consultations with experienced personal injury attorneys.
